gaussian.fresh_pair: Draw two independent PCG outputs from Gaussian[id], ldexp(value,-32), x=(u+u)-1, y=(v+v)-1. Compute xx=x*x, yy=y*y, radius=yy+xx with separate scalar operations. Repeat when radius>=1 or radius==0. Compute log(radius), multiply by -2.0, divide by radius, sqrt. Cache factor*y, set flag, return factor*x. Source constants at VA0x180610ef8=1.0 and VA0x180611180=-2.0.

MoveInput normally directly sets vx=cos(angle)*maxSpeed*fraction, vy=-sin(angle)*maxSpeed*fraction. Acceleration applied as force*dt while PhysicsComponent.mFootingLostTime>0. Additional over-speed force branch exists.
